faq.description: Have another question? Join our Discord or reach out on X.

items.title: How does Narra Agent differ from other crypto trading platforms?
items.description: Narra Agent combines research, execution, and risk management in one unified platform. While others focus on just trading or just analytics, we provide the complete intelligence stack with AI-powered insights across 50+ chains, real-time sentiment analysis, and institutional-grade execution infrastructure.

items.title: Is my capital secure with Narra Agent?
items.description: Absolutely. Narra Agent uses read-only API keys for exchange connections and non-custodial wallet integrations. Your funds never touch our systems. You maintain complete control while we provide the intelligence and automation layer on top.

items.title: What chains and protocols does Narra Agent support?
items.description: We support 50+ blockchain networks including BNB Chain, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism, and more. Integration covers 500+ DeFi protocols, major CEXs, and NFT marketplaces. New chains are added continuously based on user demand.

items.title: Do I need coding experience to use Narra Agent?
items.description: No coding required for core features. Our no-code strategy builder and pre-built templates work out of the box. However, advanced users can leverage our Python SDK and REST API for custom strategies and integrations.

items.title: What's included in each pricing tier?
items.description: All tiers include core research and portfolio tracking. Higher tiers unlock automated execution, advanced risk management, unlimited backtesting, priority data feeds, and institutional features. Check our pricing page for detailed comparisons.

items.title: Can I try Narra Agent before committing?
items.description: Yes! Start with our free tier to explore research features and portfolio tracking. When you're ready to scale, upgrade to unlock automation and advanced features. No credit card required for free tier.
